audit.whatIsWrong: Four enum rows disagreed with the packet chart and with this page's own whys: level 3 and the two item stages were given to Quinn while whys[2] calls it even, whys[5] calls it a coin flip and whys[6] says Darius reclaims the duel; level 6 was Skill while whys[4] is a clean Quinn roam window.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill and the prose already reads that way.
audit.corrected: win[2], win[4], win[5], win[6] and the matching phases sides re-cut with ratings to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold the Youmuu's timing as a clean Quinn spike on a coin-flip row.
audit.why: whys[5]: a landed Apprehend into five stacks and Guillotine still kills her at that stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly told the player to blind Darius's empowered Q — 'blind his empowered Q (the outer-blade heal/burst) and his whole all-in damage whiffs'.
audit.why: Blinding Assault hinders vision, which affects basic attacks. Decimate is an ability and lands through a blind, heal included. What the blind DOES eat is Crippling Strike, which is an empowered basic attack on a 5s cooldown. The old advice tells the player to spend an 11s cooldown on something it cannot stop.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], early, mid and report[5].t reassigned to Crippling Strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid said Apprehend leaves him with 'nothing for 20+ seconds' and nothing else gave a number.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — 26s at rank 1 is the single biggest punish window in the matchup and worth stating exactly.
audit.corrected: mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now carry 26s.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your range.
edits.after: Blinding Assault comes online and eats Crippling Strike, but a landed Apprehend still punishes a bad step.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Your spike holds, but one clean Apprehend into five stacks and Guillotine still kills you — coin flip.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in he reclaims the duel — Hemorrhage stacks plus a resetting Guillotine execute you if you get pinned.

edits.before: Q blind goes online: blind his empowered Q (the outer-blade heal/burst) and his whole all-in damage whiffs.
edits.after: Blinding Assault goes online: it eats Crippling Strike, his empowered auto — Decimate is a spell and lands anyway.

edits.before: Hold Q to blind his empowered Q swing and his next all-in auto, not just to poke
edits.after: Hold the blind for Crippling Strike — it is an auto, so the blind eats it outright

edits.before: Darius is helpless if you respect one thing: his E pull. At Levels 1-2 you simply out-range him — proc Harrier, leap in for the bonus auto, then drift back before he can close. The blind isn't online yet, so don't get greedy face-to-face; poke with autos at the edge of his reach. The moment you have Q at 3, blind his empowered Q (the outer-blade swing that heals him) and his damage and sustain both evaporate.
edits.after: Darius is helpless if you respect one thing: Apprehend. At Levels 1-2 you simply out-range him — proc Harrier, leap in for the bonus auto, then drift back before he can close. The blind isn't online yet, so don't get greedy face-to-face; poke with autos at the edge of his reach. Once you have Q at 3, blind Crippling Strike — that one is an empowered basic attack, so it whiffs. Decimate is a spell and still lands.

edits.before: This is your lane. With Q-W-E online you blind his all-in, E-vault out of his E-pull range, and W-steroid your attack speed to kite while Harrier resets shred him. Bait the E: dodge it or vault the second it lands and he has nothing for 20+ seconds. At 6 your R is for scouting and roaming, not dueling — shove him in, scan his jungle, and take over a side lane while he's stuck farming. Just never let him stack 5 Hemorrhage on you.
edits.after: This is your lane. With Q-W-E online you blind Crippling Strike, E-vault out of his pull range, and W-steroid your attack speed to kite while Harrier resets shred him. Bait Apprehend: dodge it or vault the second it lands and he has nothing for 26 seconds at rank 1. At 6 your R is for scouting and roaming, not dueling — shove him in, scan his jungle, and take a side lane while he farms. Never let him stack 5 Hemorrhage.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. Vault out + blind. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — bait it and he cannot engage. The blind eats Crippling Strike, not Decimate.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Vault out + blind. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — dodge or Vault it and he has no engage for the whole window. - Crippling Strike: 5s empowered auto, and your blind eats it. - Noxian Guillotine: 120s true damage, refreshed by a kill.

edits.before: His all-in start. Vault out + blind. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 26s at rank 1 — bait it, then you have the whole cooldown to run your pattern.
